about_short_description.short_description: Partment is an online platform where you can co-own a vacation home hassle-free.

product.name: Partment Co-Ownership Platform
product.description: A digital platform for purchasing fractional ownership in vacation homes, booking owner stays, and sharing property costs and access with other co-owners.

product.name: Partment Stays
product.description: A short- and medium-term rental platform offering curated accommodations and property-listing services for owners seeking professionally managed rental income.

product.name: Partment X
product.description: A fractional real estate investment offering that lets users buy a share of a property for a defined period and seek rental income and potential appreciation.

product.name: Property Management Services
product.description: End-to-end management for second homes and other residential properties, including furnishing, maintenance, rental operations, guest support, and performance monitoring.

product.name: Partment Resale Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for listing and discovering resale opportunities in Partment property shares, supporting secondary transactions between buyers and sellers.
